reasoning.text: Reproducibility is mid: every numeric parameter (q, psi, omega, Ninv, Barrett, widths, op counts) is firmly pinned and the impls agree on them, but the spec leaves the system's defining structure — the conflict-free bank function, crossbar permutation, rearranged-loop twiddle addressing and FSM — source-missing, so the two impls diverge on exactly those points. Fidelity is limited by the same gap: the impls reproduce a correct negacyclic radix-2/4 NTT with the right constants, but the paper's headline contributions (conflict-free mapping and no-bit-reversal datapath) are unverifiable or outright violated, leaving essentially a generic-correct NTT rather than the specific CFNTT architecture.
gaps: [operation] Paper Sec.III conflict-free bank()/offset() functions (headline result; XOR-fold is an explicit [conv] tie-break)
[operation] Twiddle-ROM rearranged-loop address function f(stage,block) that actually removes bit-reversal
[control] Exact schedule / addr_gen defining simultaneous 8-way no-conflict reads
[control] Definitive FSM transition table (three contradictory lists must be reduced to one)
[port] Host/PCIe/DMA interface: beat width, framing, coeff packing, handshake
[param] Naive-radix-4 add/sub baseline used to anchor the 20% reduction
[operation] Forward=CT/DIT vs inverse=GS/DIF convention (only 'DIT, merged psi-twist' pinned)
